vars.name: TARGET_URL
vars.description: Beads-viewer base URL to audit. In-pod this is the port-forward tunnel http://localhost:8095 (see gardenio/docs/info-density-audit-harness.md for why the public ingress is unreachable from agent pods). The harness hits {{TARGET_URL}}/plans and {{TARGET_URL}}/plans/{plan}.

vars.name: PLAN_ID
vars.description: The plan epic (type=epic + label=plan) whose /plans/{id} cockpit is audited. If empty/placeholder, step-1 picks the busiest live plan (most steps + an assistant) and passes it forward via a comment. Captured by the Playwright harness as page 'plan-detail'.

vars.name: ITERATION
vars.description: Iteration tag (fire-time ISO or date stamp) used as the output directory name under docs/plans-ux/<ITERATION>/. Keeps multiple pours from colliding. On the scheduled gardener this is wired to {{fire_time_iso}}.

vars.name: PARENT_EPIC
vars.description: Tracking epic for this work (ka-0000001353). All bug beads filed by the file-issues step are parented here so the operator can browse one tree per dimension.

steps.title: Plans UX ({{ITERATION}}): warm up {{TARGET_URL}} and pick/verify the audit plan
steps.description:
## Step 1: Boot + Warmup + Pick Audit Plan

Confirm the Plans surfaces are reachable before we burn cycles. The two
surfaces are the **index** (`GET /plans`, handler `handlePlans`) and the
**cockpit** (`GET /plans/{id}`, handler `handlePlanDetail`). Both are reads
behind ambient auth.

### Prereq: open a local tunnel + mint a bearer

Follow `gardenio/docs/info-density-audit-harness.md` verbatim. `{{TARGET_URL}}`
is expected to be `http://localhost:8095`. Agent pods have no public route to
the viewer; port-forward to `svc/gardenio-beads-viewer:8095` and authenticate
with a Keycloak `client_credentials` bearer (advice `ka-0000006483`, helper
`gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh`). Also port-forward
`svc/gardenio-beads:8080` and bootstrap the operator row via
`POST /v1/operators/me/aliases` so authenticated pages render real content and
the operator-only spawn/step controls appear.

```bash
export POD_NAMESPACE=${POD_NAMESPACE:-$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace 2>/dev/null || echo gardenio-system)}
export KC_RELEASE_NAME=${KC_RELEASE_NAME:-$POD_NAMESPACE}
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh
VIEWER_BEARER=$(mint_client_credentials_token) || { echo 'BLOCKED: bearer mint failed'; exit 1; }
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads 8080:8080 > /tmp/beads-daemon-pf.log 2>&1 &
BEADS_PF_PID=$!
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads-viewer 8095:8095 > /tmp/beads-viewer-pf.log 2>&1 &
PF_PID=$!
trap 'kill $PF_PID $BEADS_PF_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "http://localhost:8095/health" && break; sleep 1; done
curl -fsS -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"kind":"agent","subject":"gardenio-plans-ux-audit","source":"audit-bootstrap"}' \
  http://localhost:8080/v1/operators/me/aliases | jq .
```

Without `VIEWER_BEARER`, every request returns 401 (oidcauth middleware).

### Pick the audit plan (if {{PLAN_ID}} is empty/placeholder)

The cockpit audit is only meaningful for a plan with real structure. If
`{{PLAN_ID}}` is empty or a placeholder, discover the busiest live plan — the
one with the most steps and (ideally) a bound assistant, so it stresses the
timeline, progress bar, and assistant lane:

```bash
kd list --type=epic --status=open --json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[] | select((.labels//[]) | index("plan")) | .id + "\t" + (.title//"")' | head -40
```

Prefer a plan with several children and an assistant chip. Avoid an empty,
freshly-marked epic. Record the chosen plan ID + why in a comment and pass it
forward as `{{PLAN_ID}}` (downstream steps read it from this step's comment).

### Verify the surfaces

With `VIEWER_BEARER` set, all of these must be < 400:

```bash
PLAN_ID=<plan-id-from-above>
for path in "/plans" "/plans?operated_by=" "/plans/${PLAN_ID}" "/plans/${PLAN_ID}/events"; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "{{TARGET_URL}}${path}")
  printf '%-40s -> %s\n' "$path" "$code"
done
```

### Deliverables (post as comments, then close)
- Comment: chosen plan ID + how it was selected (busiest / most-branching + has assistant).
- Comment: per-path HTTP status table.
- Comment: 'PASS' or per-path failure detail.

If `/plans` or the cockpit returns >= 400, do NOT close — file a bug parented
to {{PARENT_EPIC}} and BLOCK (comment 'BLOCKED' and stop). A broken Plans
surface is itself the highest-severity finding.

steps.title: Plans UX ({{ITERATION}}): capture screenshots + DOM for /plans and /plans/{{PLAN_ID}}
steps.description:
## Step 2: Capture

Run the Playwright harness against `{{TARGET_URL}}` for the index + cockpit at
BOTH desktop and narrow (375x667) viewports and store output under
`docs/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/`. The dimension that Matt named — the
UI being responsive — lives in the narrow captures, so both viewports are
mandatory, not optional.

### Prereq: re-establish the tunnel + bearer (Step-1 prereq block).

### Steps
1. Branch off fresh main:
   ```bash
   git fetch origin && git checkout main && git pull --ff-only
   git checkout -b chore/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}
   ```
2. Capture the index (show-all) and the cockpit at both viewports. Reuse the
   canonical screenshot harness if it grows a plans page; otherwise drive
   Playwright directly with the bearer as an extraHTTPHeader:
   ```bash
   mkdir -p docs/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/{screenshots/{desktop,narrow},html}
   for spec in "plans-index:/plans?operated_by=" "plan-detail:/plans/{{PLAN_ID}}"; do
     slug=${spec%%:*}; path=${spec#*:}
     curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "{{TARGET_URL}}${path}" \
       -o "docs/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/html/${slug}.html"
   done
   ```
   For the PNGs use a small Playwright script (viewports {width:1280,height:900}
   and {width:375,height:667}) that sets `Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER`
   as an extraHTTPHeader and screenshots `plans-index` + `plan-detail` at each
   viewport into `captures/screenshots/{desktop,narrow}/`.
3. Commit:
   ```bash
   git add docs/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}/
   git commit -m "chore(plans-ux): capture {{ITERATION}} for /plans + /plans/{{PLAN_ID}}"
   ```

### Deliverables
- Branch `chore/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}` with `captures/{html,screenshots}/` populated.
- Comment: `du -sh` of captures + commit SHA + confirmation all four
  desktop+narrow PNGs exist (plans-index + plan-detail × 2 viewports).

If the harness fails, root-cause it (dead port-forward in
`/tmp/beads-viewer-pf.log`; re-mint the bearer if expired) and BLOCK.

steps.title: Plans UX ({{ITERATION}}): compute objective PACES metrics
steps.description:
## Step 3: Measure (objective; no judgement)

Compute the objective signals for each PACES dimension from the captured
HTML/SVG/DOM + a ground-truth `kd` walk. Write a small helper under
`gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/tools/measure-plans.py` (mirror
`measure-maps.py`) that ingests the captures dir and emits
`docs/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}/metrics.json`.

Rubric: `gardenio/docs/plans-ux-rubric.md` §2.

### P — Plan clarity (from plans-index.html)
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `plan_card_count` | count of `li.plan-card` in the index |
| `kd_list_plan_epic_count` | ground truth: `kd list --type=epic --status=open --json \| jq '[.[]\|select((.labels//[])\|index("plan"))]\|length'` |
| `card_vs_truth_delta` | `kd_list_plan_epic_count - plan_card_count` (0 ⇒ every plan drawn) |
| `cards_with_progress` | count of cards rendering `.plan-progress-label` |
| `cards_with_next_step` | count of cards rendering `.plan-card-step` |

### A — Assistant (from plans-index.html + plan-detail.html)
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `assistant_chip_states` | tally of `.plan-asst-chip` / `.plan-assistant-chip-*` classes (live/waking/parked/none) |
| `cockpit_lane_state` | the `data-state` attr on `section#plan-agent` |
| `spawn_form_present` | 1 if `form.plan-assistant-form` present on the cockpit (operator auth), else 0 |
| `open_link_present` | 1 if `a.plan-agent-terminal` present (agent bound) |

### C — Cockpit fidelity (from plan-detail.html)
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `timeline_step_count` | count of `li.plan-tl-step` |
| `direct_issue_child_count` | ground truth: reverse parent-child issue children of {{PLAN_ID}} via kd |
| `step_vs_truth_delta` | `direct_issue_child_count - timeline_step_count` |
| `is_done_count` / `is_active_count` | count of `.plan-tl-step.is-done` / `.is-active` |
| `narrative_rendered` | 1 if `section#plan-narrative` has non-trivial body |
| `dangling_chips` | count of blocker/section chips whose target id does not resolve |

### E — Ergonomics (from plan-detail.html)
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `operator_controls` | count of add-step + close/reopen + phase-reorder + mark buttons present |
| `sse_anchor_present` | 1 if `[data-plan-events]` present with a `/plans/{id}/events` href |

### S — Skin / responsive (from screenshots + narrow HTML)
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `overflow_index_narrow` | `scrollWidth - innerWidth` at 375px for the index (>1 ⇒ FAIL) |
| `overflow_detail_narrow` | same for the cockpit |
| `grid_tracks_narrow` | computed `grid-template-columns` token count on `.plan-grid` at 375px (1 ⇒ collapsed) |
| `near_white_ratio` | desktop pixel-density of both pages (reuse measure-density.py) |

### Correctness (both surfaces)
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `template_leaks` | count of literal `{{` / `}}` / `<no value>` in the body |
| `error_markers` | count of `error`, `failed to`, `nil`, `panic` (case-insensitive) |

Any `template_leaks > 0`, `error_markers > 0`, nonzero `*_vs_truth_delta`
beyond the expected cap, or `overflow_* > 1` is an automatic fail flag for its
dimension.

### Deliverables
- `measure-plans.py` + `metrics.json` committed on the branch.
- Comment: compact table of headline numbers per dimension.
- If a screenshot is unreadable, mark its block `null` and warn — do not BLOCK.

steps.title: Plans UX ({{ITERATION}}): score Plan / Assistant / Cockpit / Ergonomics / Skin (PACES)
steps.description:
## Step 4: Judge — the PACES rubric

Produce a 0-10 score + verdict for each of the five dimensions, combining the
objective metrics (step 3) with a visual review of the screenshots. **You MUST
visually inspect** the desktop AND narrow PNGs for both `plans-index` and
`plan-detail` with the Read tool — the screenshot is the source of truth;
metrics only triage. Plans is a PRIMARY work surface, so hold the bar high.

Rubric definitions, auto-caps, and score bands: `gardenio/docs/plans-ux-rubric.md`
§2–§3. Summary of the five dimensions:

- **P — Plan clarity**: does the /plans index tell the truth at a glance?
- **A — Assistant (spawn + responsiveness)**: THE headline dimension — spawn
  works (200, lane binds, chip honest), state is unambiguous, feels instant.
- **C — Cockpit fidelity**: steps + narrative are complete and correct.
- **E — Ergonomics**: operator controls discoverable, wired, honest feedback.
- **S — Skin / responsive**: no overflow at 375px, grid collapses, looks designed.

Weight the roll-up toward A and S — Matt's explicit asks. Never let an A or S
regression hide behind a high mean.

### Output
`docs/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}/verdicts.json`:
```json
{
  "iteration": "{{ITERATION}}", "plan_id": "{{PLAN_ID}}", "target_url": "{{TARGET_URL}}",
  "scores": {
    "plan":       {"score": 0, "verdict": "broken|weak|ok|good|excellent", "observations": "...", "issues": ["..."], "recommendations": ["..."]},
    "assistant":  {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []},
    "cockpit":    {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []},
    "ergonomics": {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []},
    "skin":       {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []}
  },
  "overall": {"score": 0.0, "headline": "one-line state-of-the-plans-UX"}
}
```
Score bands: 0-3 broken, 4-5 weak, 6-7 ok, 8-9 good, 10 excellent.
`overall.score` = mean of the five.

### Deliverables
- `verdicts.json` committed on the branch.
- Comment: a 5-row PACES scorecard (dimension | score | verdict | top recommendation) + the headline.
- Full `verdicts.json` pasted into a comment for the file-issues step.

steps.title: Plans UX ({{ITERATION}}): file bug beads per low-scoring dimension
steps.description:
## Step 5: File Issues

For every dimension in `verdicts.json` scoring **<= 7** (anything short of
'good') file ONE bug bead with that dimension's concrete recommendations. The
bar is deliberately high (<= 7, not <= 6) because Plans is a primary work
surface.

### Per-dimension bug bead
```bash
kd create "Plans UX: <Dimension> scored <N>/10 — <one-line>" \
  --type=bug --project=gardenio -p 2 \
  -l project:gardenio -l area:beads-viewer -l kind:plans-ux -l "pace:<dimension>" \
  --description "## Plans UX audit context

Iteration: {{ITERATION}}
Target: {{TARGET_URL}}/plans (+ /plans/{{PLAN_ID}})
Dimension: <Plan|Assistant|Cockpit|Ergonomics|Skin>
Score: <N>/10  (verdict: <verdict>)

## Observations
<verbatim from verdicts.json>

## Issues
- <bullet>

## Recommended fixes
- <bullet>

## Evidence
- Index desktop:   docs/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/plans-index.png
- Cockpit desktop: docs/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/plan-detail.png
- Narrow:          docs/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/narrow/
- Metrics:         docs/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}/metrics.json

parent({{PARENT_EPIC}})"
```

### Deduplication (per dimension)
Before filing, search for an open bead with the same dimension scope:
```bash
kd list --status=open -l kind:plans-ux -l "pace:<dimension>" 2>&1
```
If one exists, comment the new iteration's score + evidence on it (reference
both iterations) instead of filing a duplicate. If the dimension has recovered
to 8+ this iteration, comment that on the open bead and propose closing it.

### Deliverables
- Comment listing each filed-or-updated bug bead ID + its dimension + score.
- If all five dimensions score 8+, comment 'All five PACES dimensions >= 8 this
  iteration — Plans UX is flagship-ready 🎉' and close the step.
- Do NOT close {{PARENT_EPIC}} — the report step rolls up first.

steps.title: Plans UX ({{ITERATION}}): publish roll-up report and land the MR
steps.description:
## Step 6: Report + Land MR Produce a single rolled-up report on the parent epic and land the captures+metrics+verdicts on main via an MR (so future iterations diff). ### Steps 1. Build `docs/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md`: - Header: iteration, target URL, audit plan, date. - PACES scorecard: 5-row table — dimension | score | verdict | filed bug bead. - Headline (one-line state of the Plans UX) + overall mean. - Inline embed: desktop screenshots of `plans-index` and `plan-detail`. - Trends: if a previous iteration exists at `docs/plans-ux//`, diff each dimension's score + `near_white_ratio` + step/card counts; flag regressions. Call out A (Assistant) and S (Skin) trends explicitly — the operator's asks. - Index of bug beads filed/updated. 2. Commit + push + open MR: ```bash git add docs/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md git commit -m "chore(plans-ux): {{ITERATION}} roll-up report" git push -u origin chore/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}} glab mr create \ --title "chore(plans-ux): {{ITERATION}} audit" \ --description "Automated Plans UX (PACES) audit for {{TARGET_URL}}/plans.\n\nReport: docs/plans-ux/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md\nParent: {{PARENT_EPIC}}\nOperator: Matt Baker" \ --remove-source-branch --squash-before-merge ``` 3. Wait for CI green; on a transient flake, retrigger the pipeline (NEVER close/reopen — global advice on pipeline retriggers). 4. Self-merge once green (operator pre-authorized via global advice ka-0000002230 for gardenio repos). 5. Comment on parent epic {{PARENT_EPIC}}: ``` Iteration {{ITERATION}} complete. Target: {{TARGET_URL}}/plans (plan {{PLAN_ID}}) PACES: Plan

/10 · Assistant /10 · Cockpit /10 · Ergonomics /10 · Skin /10 (overall ) Bug beads: Report: ``` ### Deliverables - MR URL posted as comment on this step bead. - MR merged on main. - Comment on {{PARENT_EPIC}} with the rolled-up PACES summary. - Close this step bead. This closes the molecule. The gardener trigger fires the next iteration on its cadence — incremental, continual progress toward a flagship Plans surface.
